hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$sid" ] && sid=$$; port=$(( $(printf '%s' "$sid" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1) % 150 * 2 + 5200 )); wport=$((port+1)); lan=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || echo 127.0.0.1); if lsof -iTCP:$port -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else ( nohup npm run dev -w @coachvision/board -- --host --port $port --strictPort >"/tmp/cv-board-$port.log" 2>&1 & ); fi; if [ -f apps/web/package.json ]; then if lsof -iTCP:$wport -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else ( nohup npm run dev -w @coachvision/web -- -H 0.0.0.0 -p $wport >"/tmp/cv-web-$wport.log" 2>&1 & ); fi; web="Website (Next.js): http://$lan:$wport/ (log /tmp/cv-web-$wport.log). "; else web="apps/web does not exist yet, so only the board started. "; fi; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Auto-started this session dev servers. Board (Vite): http://%s:%s/ (log /tmp/cv-board-%s.log). %sKeep these URLs as always-available clickable links and re-share them whenever showing a change. This project starts in plan mode."}}\n' "$lan" "$port" "$port" "$web"
